big_case.notes: Supreme Court review of Section 11(a)'s misleading-omissions standard for intra-quarter financial data in registration statements (following Omnicare and Macquarie) carries substantial practical consequences for IPO disclosures and strict-liability exposure across U.S. capital markets, as reflected by Solicitor General/SEC, Chamber of Commerce, and SIFMA participation, while remaining a targeted statutory securities question rather than a constitutional or structural public-law landmark.
